description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

🌟 Are you a passionate, hands-on, and creative superstar? Join us as a Masterbrand Intern at DiDi! You'll be at the forefront of shaping our brand's success in the SSL market.

Innovative strategies that captivate and resonate with the SSL audience.

In this role, you'll be...

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Performance marketing is being rebuilt from first principles. The manual processes of bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result. This is not incremental improvement. It is a different model.

As Growth Workflow Specialist (Performance & Paid Growth), you sit at the intersection of paid growth expertise and AI systems thinking. You are the domain expert who makes the automation intelligent. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design. Your job is to define the logic, what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels, and then work alongside the build team to bring it to life.

While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it.

This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role.

The opportunity


Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing
Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations
QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it
Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it
Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current
Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself
Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions


What You Bring


4+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply
Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements. You think in logic, not just tactics
Comfort with data, you can read a performance dashboard, interpret signal from noise, and define what an agent should optimize for
Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs
Strong written communication, the workflow specs you write become the blueprints engineers build from. Clarity matters.
High agency, you define the work, you don't wait for it to be defined for you


Nice to haves


Experience with marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems
Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. This attention to detail spans from content in an email to the editing of a video ad or testimonial.
Ownership: You take ownership of each task and project and see it through to completion and the desired result/outcome. You go further to put your stamp of approval on all work going out. Double-checking work is commonplace, but relying on others to catch mistakes and uphold quality is not.
Great Time Management: You easily adapt to different types of workloads, adjust to unexpected changes, and manage multiple tasks or projects simultaneously. You should be able to handle multiple responsibilities across our core marketing activities with quality and the appropriate velocity.
Strong Communication and Collaboration: You need strong communication and collaboration skills to work across sales, marketing, and client success team members daily. You will also need to be able to write and convey intentional, clear, and personalized messages to clients and prospects.




Duties:

Work closely with our sales team to increase the effectiveness of lead generation
Report on KPIs and metrics weekly

We pay you for the value you have and create at Rotate Digital.

Pay range is dependent on experience.

$1,500 to $2,500 USD monthly salary
Annual pay raise increase based on tenure (8%)
Paid Time-Off




How to Apply

To complete this application successfully and move on to the next step in the hiring process, set aside enough time to approach this first application the same way you would a final interview. You will be asked highly technical questions and asked to provide solutions to real-life problems that come with this role. You will also be asked to record a video, so have a camera and a microphone ready.
Completing the application form fully with all the questions answered is mandatory, and an incomplete application will not be considered.
From our end, we promise to review every single candidate in detail and carefully consider all the applicants.
Ready? Use the Apply link to go to our internal Careers page and start the application process there.
You’ll hear from us if we want to move forward in the application process. Please allow us up to two weeks to review your application, as we want to make sure we carefully consider your replies.

description:
About the job

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing marketing consultancy and growth agency specializing in the medical aesthetics and regenerative medicine sector. Operating globally across the US, UK, Australia, and beyond, the team helps premium clinics and MedSpas transition from inconsistent results to predictable, $100K+ monthly revenue. By moving beyond traditional lead generation, they implement comprehensive growth frameworks that optimize high-ticket patient acquisition, sales conversion systems, and client retention strategies for treatments like body sculpting, injectables, and advanced laser therapies.

As a performance-driven scale-up, the company is dedicated to solving the complex operational and marketing challenges faced by modern aesthetic practices. The team fosters a results-oriented and innovative environment, focusing on delivering measurable impact through structured systems rather than generic advertising. This is an opportunity to join a strategic, forward-thinking organization that is redefining how premium health and beauty businesses scale their operations in a competitive international market.

Job Summary

Most agencies stop caring once the lead lands. We don't. At this company, we recognize that the gap between an interested lead and a paid deposit is where high-ticket aesthetics is truly won or lost. We have world-class lead generation and robust systems; what we need is a dedicated CRO Lead to own the "click-to-booking" journey. You will turn anecdotal feedback into a systematic conversion machine, acting as the bridge between creative intelligence and bottom-line results. If you thrive on watching session recordings, debunking objections, and proving your hypotheses with hard evidence, this is the role where you can truly own the funnel.

Requirements


Demonstrable CRO Experience: A proven track record of running tests, predicting outcomes, and measuring results
High-Ticket Lead Gen Expertise: Experience optimizing landing pages and forms specifically for high-intent, considered purchases
Behavioral Tool Proficiency: Mastery of session recording tools, heatmaps, and funnel analytics to draw qualitative conclusions
Cultural Alignment: Strong understanding of the American consumer mindset, particularly regarding trust, proof, and high-ticket service expectations
Timezone Alignment: Ability to work primarily within USA business hours to collaborate effectively with the team and partner clinics
Data-Driven Communication: Expert written and verbal English with the ability to present data-backed findings confidently to stakeholders
Nice-to-Haves
Industry Background: Previous experience in MedSpa, aesthetics, or healthcare lead generation
Platform Knowledge: Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)
Sales Insight: Experience reviewing sales or setter calls to extract conversion bottlenecks
Portfolio Management: Experience managing conversion performance across 20+ simultaneous client accounts


Benefits

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀 Career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling agency

🎯 Performance-based incentives

📈 Long-term stability and high-level strategic ownership

🧠 Collaborative culture with top-tier marketing talent

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As part of DiDi's Entrega business line, B2C is a brand-new, high-potential service offering. We provide last-mile delivery solutions for businesses, fulfilling orders coming directly from their own channels (app, website, or phone). As a Senior Analyst, you will be the analytical backbone of this rapidly scaling business unit. You will bridge the gap between complex data and real-world business growth. This role is a unique hybrid of data analytics, merchant operations, and product strategy—you will not only find the "why" behind the numbers but also design the "how" to overcome business challenges.

In this role, you'll be...


Data Monitoring & Deep-Dives: Own the daily monitoring of merchant performance, volume growth, and operational health. Perform rigorous, deep-dive root-cause analyses on data anomalies, such as volume drops, or SLA breaches.
Qualitative Merchant & User Research: Lead structured interviews and feedback sessions with merchants and end-users to gather qualitative insights, ensuring we understand the story behind the data.
Translating Insights into Action: Synthesize data metrics and qualitative feedback into concrete operational action plans and structured product capability requests to continuously improve the B2C offering.
Delivery Ops Collaboration: Partner closely with the core Entrega Delivery Operations team to improve fulfillment rates, and ensure our logistics capabilities match our merchants' high expectations.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience: 2+ years of highly analytical experience within a tech platform, management consulting firm, O2O/Logistics startup, or business operations environment.
Data-Driven Acuity: A proven ability to leverage large datasets to derive meaningful, business-driving insights. Must-have: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel / Google Sheets
Startup Mindset: A curious and detail-oriented problem solver who takes full ownership of results. You have stellar task-management skills to navigate multiple moving parts, ensuring no task or follow-up falls through the cracks in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Comunication & Language: Exceptional communication and presentation skills. Fluent to native proficiency in both English and Spanish is required for working effectively within our international and cross-cultural matrix environment



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

En Sigma, “Alimentos deliciosos para una vida mejor” es nuestro propósito, que nos inspira a ofrecer productos de gran sabor que mejoran la vida de las personas y del planeta. 

Buscamos talentos que compartan esta pasión y que quieran ser parte de un gran lugar para trabajar.




Responsabilidades principales:

1. Cerciorar asistencia a través de solicitud de la firma en la lista de asistencia para el envío de incidencias

2. Revisar reportes de ventas de devoluciones, lectura de equipos por medio de la información proporcionada por control operativo para un seguimiento diario.

3. Generar el plan de acción diaria (PAD) imprimiendo la información correspondiente para otorgarla a cada vendedor/a producto a bordo

4. Asegurar que todo/a vendedor/a cuente con las herramientas de venta, entregándoles el PAD y la tarjeta de venta para ejecutar sus operaciones

5. Revisar el reporte de ventas con cada vendedor/a con base en la ruta y resultados para el seguimiento operativo

6. Revisar FINEX con cada vendedor/a a través del seguimiento operativo e individual para cumplir con la productividad y efectividad

7. Brindar seguimiento a portafolio de productos con base en el reporte para cumplir con el objetivo de cobertura

8. Salir a ruta a bordo con el/la vendedor/a con base en el plan de trabajo para garantizar una ejecución efectiva

9. Salir a ruta patrulla en base al plan de trabajo para revisión de indicadores por ruta y benchmarking

10. Actualizar tablero de operación diaria a través de datos para visualizar resultados de venta

11. Validar gastos autorizando la comprobación para entregar a caja por el/la vendedor/a y generar el depósito correspondiente

12. Generar reporte de gastos en gasolina mediante el análisis de la información para verificar crédito de tarjetas accord.

13. Motivar al personal a cargo mediante un coaching personal de acuerdo a sus necesidades diarias y cumplimiento de objetivos

14. Asegurar que el personal a cargo cuente con las herramientas necesarias (hand held, utilitario, uniforme) para ejecutar sus operaciones diarias

15. Verificar que la información de la venta diaria esta descargada correctamente en SAP y SOL SYSTEM revisando el semáforo para que el departamento de almacén y picking center cuente con los pedidos para realizar las cargas.

16. Conocer y ejercer continuamente la política de seguridad a través del involucramiento y participación en 12 mejores prácticas.

title: Welsh Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
About the job

Are you an experienced voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and engaging voice experiences across education, entertainment, accessibility, and beyond. That training data begins with you—your voice expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for a highly skilled voice acting professional who can bring nuance, clarity, and authenticity to training data in Welsh. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, record and evaluate speech samples, and provide expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation to strengthen Welsh voice models.

On a typical day, you will record scripted material in Welsh, assess AI-generated outputs for linguistic accuracy and naturalness, annotate errors, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines.

Demonstrated experience in professional voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work in Welsh is required. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills and attention to detail are essential. A high-quality recording setup—including a reliable microphone and a quiet environment—is required.

Ready to channel your Welsh voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. description:
About the job

Senior Visual Designer

The Company

Wizeline is a global digital services company helping mid-size to Fortune 500 companies build, scale, and deliver high-quality digital products and services.

We thrive in solving our customer’s challenges through human-centered experiences, digital core modernization, and intelligence everywhere (AI/ML and data). We help them succeed in building digital capabilities that bring technology to the core of their business.

Our People

At Wizeline, we are a team of over 2,000 people spread across 25+ countries. We understand that great technology begins with great talent and diversity of thought. Our business was built on doing well and doing good, and our values of Ownership, Innovation, Community, and Diversity & Inclusion are embedded within our company’s DNA. We are committed to offering our Wizeliners the opportunity to create their career path and develop the skills needed to achieve their personal goals.

Community Impact

We are invested in making a positive impact in our communities. That’s why we created Wizeline Academy, a free, community-based education program that teaches high-value skills to workers looking to advance their tech industry careers. As of 2021, Academy has served more than 27,000 students across 624 courses. Wizeliners have the opportunity to upskill by taking Wizeline Academy courses and can also share their expertise by delivering classes to students.

The Role: Senior Visual Designer

As a Senior Visual Designer you will create delightful interfaces and high-quality visuals that meet the client's needs.

Your Day-to-Day

This Job Posting Is For a Senior Visual Designer On Our Team. Here's What You'll Be Doing In Your Day-to-day Work


Create delightful interfaces and high-quality visuals that meet the client's needs.
Convey and present visual concepts with a supporting user-centered approach.
Lead the UI and branding design direction for products and interfaces.
Define how users will move through a platform and achieve their end goals by designing user and system flows. Use these as communication tools with development teams and stakeholders.
Improve existing interactions and visuals with design systems and visual narratives.
Ability to convey high-quality designs (brand assets, mockups, prototypes, libraries, and design specs) for client presentations and development hand-offs in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to grow and shape other people's ideas by translating brand attributes to visual signifiers on digital products. 
Stay on top of the latest standards, best practices, and trends in the Visual Design field. 
Collaboration with cross-functional teams including UX Designers, Technical Writers, and Software Engineers, to deliver polished and scalable digital products for world-class companies.


Are You a Fit?

Sounds awesome, right? Now, let’s make sure you’re a good fit for the role.

Must-have Skills


3+ years of experience in digital product design.
Good understanding of interface design systems for digital products, typography, art direction, and visual communication.
Strong portfolio demonstrating a passion for digital products, branding, and/or product design.
Have expertise in some of the following:
Atomic design
Design systems and component libraries
Visual hierarchy
Interaction design
Accessibility
Responsive design
Visual design principles: typography, colors, grids, and layouts
Branding
Illustration or other visual languages

Nice-to-have Skills


Basic understanding of frameworks like Material Design, Bootstrap, CSS
A bachelor’s degree or relevant training in graphic design, digital communications, design, experience design, or equivalent work experience.
Self-starter, curious, and motivated.
Strong English communication skills in person, on paper, and over the video to allow a smooth interaction with our international teams and clients.
Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, CC Suite, InVision, Abstract.
Proactiveness to collaborate with the Wizeline Leadership team and peers to align with our goals and maintain an ongoing feedback cycle. 


Why You Should Apply

Still Not Convinced You Should Apply? Here Are Some Of The Things That Make Wizeline Different From Other Technology Services Companies

Our Values

At Wizeline, we value innovation, community, and ownership. Our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and respect fosters an environment where everyone does well and does good. We're proud to be recognized by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation in response to our inclusive corporate policies and best practices for LGBTQ+ employees.

Our Culture

We offer exceptional career growth and learning opportunities to our employees with skill development workshops, mentoring programs, and support for side projects or entrepreneurial work. We ranked 7th on Expansión’s Super Companies 2021 list.

Our Benefits And Perks

We offer competitive compensation and employee-centric benefits, including industry-leading maternity and paternity leave, wellness programs, and remote work opportunities. All Wizeliners have access to continuous learning opportunities through Wizeline Academy, including cloud certifications, mentorship, LinkedIn Learning & Udemy, and in-house technical bootcamps developed by our experts in the field.

In recognition of our superb employee benefits, we debuted on Quartz’s list of the Best Companies for Remote Workers and ranked 5th on Expansión’s Super Workspaces 2021 list.

Our Global Family

To support the global nature of our business and help our employees grow beyond their technical skills, we offer free virtual English and Spanish language classes as well as provide immigration support when applicable. Before COVID-19, we had a robust Work Abroad program in place, which we plan to continue once it’s safe to do so.

#AllAreWelcomeHere

Wizeline creates and fosters a diverse, inclusive, and harassment-free workplace where everyone can achieve their potential. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Please note that by submitting your application, you agree with the terms and conditions of our Privacy Policy.

description:
About the job

¿Estás buscando profundizar tus habilidades técnicas y construir una base sólida para una carrera actuarial? ¿Disfrutas trabajar con datos, resolver problemas y apoyar a un equipo que brinda conocimientos a los clientes? Este podría ser tu próximo paso.

Este es un puesto híbrido basado en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México. Disfrutarás de la flexibilidad de trabajar tanto de manera remota como presencial después de un período inicial de capacitación, mientras construyes conexiones con colegas globales en un espacio dinámico en nuestro Centro de Capacidades Globales (GCC).

Cómo será tu día a día

Desempeñarás un papel clave en la preparación, validación y organización de datos que respaldan nuestras herramientas actuariales, modelos y entregables para los clientes. Trabajando estrechamente con colegas actuariales senior, ayudarás a garantizar que los datos que alimentan nuestros análisis sean precisos, completos y estén listos para usar.

Importar y organizar grandes conjuntos de datos de múltiples fuentes (archivos de censo, reclamaciones, primas, etc.)
Realizar limpieza, validación y conciliación de datos para asegurar la calidad de los mismos.
Preparar archivos de entrada estandarizados para modelos y herramientas actuariales, siguiendo plantillas y requisitos de datos establecidos.
Utilizar funciones avanzadas en MS Excel para transformar datos crudos en entradas estructuradas y listas para el modelo.
Ayudar con las verificaciones de calidad en datos y exhibiciones utilizadas en informes financieros y materiales para clientes.


Cómo esta oportunidad es diferente

Este puesto está diseñado como un sólido punto de entrada técnico al trabajo actuarial en salud, con un fuerte enfoque en datos, la base de todo análisis actuarial. Obtendrás experiencia práctica trabajando con los mismos conjuntos de datos y herramientas que utilizan los actuarios senior para fijación de precios, reservas e informes financieros, aprendiendo cómo los datos de alta calidad fluyen en modelos como los de “Incurred But Not Paid” (IBNP), modelos de Valor Actuarial y herramientas de precios.

Estamos buscando candidatos que sean detallistas, curiosos y motivados para construir una carrera en trabajo actuarial y basado en datos.

Fluidez en inglés a nivel B2-C1 (o equivalente) es requerida para trabajar eficazmente con equipos globales.


Educación

Título universitario en Ciencias Actuariales, Matemáticas, Estadística o campos relacionados.

description:
About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Customer Impact sits at the intersection of customer experience and engineering accountability. As an Associate on the Bug Review team, you will investigate flawed user experiences, verify and escalate bugs through structured cross-functional workflows, and drive visibility on open platform issues so resolution doesn't stall. Bug Review is the triage layer to separate signal from noise, ensuring Engineering receives verified, credible escalations instead of a flood of unvetted reports.

The Bug Review Associate is the front line of that triage layer. You'll investigate incoming bug reports, verify reproducibility and impact, and manage tickets through their Jira lifecycle, turning raw customer signal into evidence Engineering can act on. This is a high-volume, detail-driven role: you'll work a defined queue of tickets each day, applying consistent investigation standards so that what reaches our Sr. Specialists and Engineering is already vetted.

Because many of the reports you're investigating come from riders or drivers who had a genuinely bad experience, this role also requires direct, empathetic communication with customers. You're often the person following up on an issue that upset them.

This role is part of a new HQ Associate model based in Mexico, built to bring bug review in-house with tighter tooling access, stronger quality control, and closer partnership with the broader teams. Associates report directly into the Customer Impact structure.

Responsibilities


Investigate and triage incoming bug reports against defined criteria (reproducibility, severity, customer impact)

description:
About the job

We are posting this role as Customer Support Specialist, which is the more standard market title. At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Support Specialist (or PSS). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.




About Edstruments

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.




Role Overview

The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and email, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and emails, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. You handle most questions yourself by checking our documentation and Slack history first, escalate with what you have already tried and found, and keep partners and teammates updated without being asked. Over time, you will have opportunities to take on more advanced roles as you grow with the company.




Key Responsibilities
First-Contact Resolution: Independently troubleshoot and resolve partner inquiries, checking our documentation and Slack history before escalating, ensuring a 70% first-contact resolution rate for partner inquiries. [Within the first 3 months of joining].
Response Time: Respond to partner inquiries within 5 minutes for chats and 3 hours for emails during your regular business hours. [Ongoing].
Ticket Management: Manage support conversations in Intercom and track work on Trello cards to ensure all issues are resolved promptly. Close 90% of inquiries within 48 hours.
Client Onboarding: Assist with the initial setup of our systems when a new client onboards to ensure successful data syncs with a 90% success rate.
Vendor Outreach & Admin: Provide support with vendor outreach and administrative tasks, as needed. [Ongoing].
Collaboration: Work with the Partner Success and Product teams to communicate findings from partner interactions and ensure partner needs are addressed. [Ongoing].




Key Outcomes
Achieve a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating or higher for partner support interactions (chat/email).
Close 90% of support tickets within 48 hours of receiving inquiries.
Ensure 90% success rate for assigned client onboarding tasks.
Own inquiries end to end: resolve the majority independently and close the loop with the partner, escalating only with clear context on what you’ve already tried.




Must-Have Qualifications
2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.
Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot software-related issues.
Experience with support and ticketing tools (Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and a proven ability to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.
Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to research answers, draft partner replies, and work faster.
Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision: you find answers, make a judgment call, and proactively communicate status without being chased.




Preferred Qualifications
Experience in customer support for SaaS platforms or other software solutions.
Experience in vendor outreach or administrative tasks.
Background in the education or nonprofit sectors is a plus.




Logistical Notes

This is a 100% remote role with a flexible start date, but availability during US Pacific Time business hours (8 am - 5 pm) is required.

Edstruments does not and will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its hiring decisions or other activities.




Compensation

The salary range for this role is $1,000-$2,000/month.

Why Edstruments?

Mission-Driven Work: Work with a team passionate about improving financial processes for K12 and nonprofit organizations.
Growth Opportunities: We offer potential for career advancement and development as the company scales.
Remote Flexibility: Join a 100% remote team with a flexible start date.

About Us - Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics And SciAps.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.

SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.

We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Precision is at the heart of what we do – our leading, high-tech instruments and software equip our customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.

Join our Monterrey Center of Excellence and support our U.S. and Canada operations through accurate shipment data entry, appointment scheduling, tracking, and resolution of delivery exceptions. description:
About the job

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Specialist - Food Science based in Mexico.

This remote opportunity is ideal for a customer-focused professional who enjoys building lasting client relationships while supporting businesses in regulated industries. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact throughout the customer journey, providing consultative guidance, coordinating projects, and ensuring an outstanding client experience from inquiry to completion. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver laboratory testing and labeling solutions while helping customers understand technical information in a clear and practical way. The position combines customer success, inside sales, and project coordination in a dynamic remote environment where organization, responsiveness, and communication are essential. This is an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping customers achieve compliance and successfully bring products to market.

Accountabilities

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will own the customer relationship from the initial inquiry through project completion, ensuring a seamless and high-quality experience. Your responsibilities will include:


Responding promptly to inbound web and phone inquiries while serving as the primary point of contact for customers.
Conducting consultative conversations to understand customer objectives and recommend appropriate laboratory testing, labeling, and related services.
Preparing, presenting, and following up on proposals while guiding qualified opportunities through the sales process.
Managing customer relationships after project initiation by coordinating onboarding, project timelines, status updates, report delivery, and follow-up activities.
Collaborating with internal teams to ensure laboratory testing, labeling projects, and customer commitments remain aligned.
Monitoring project progress, addressing customer questions, resolving routine billing inquiries, and maintaining accurate documentation within CRM and project management systems.
Identifying opportunities for additional services while maintaining a trusted advisor relationship with customers.
Contributing customer feedback and process improvement ideas to enhance service quality and the overall customer experience.


Requirements

The ideal candidate combines customer relationship management expertise with strong organizational skills and the ability to communicate technical information effectively. Candidates should possess:


At least 5 years of experience in customer success, account management, consultative inside sales, business development, or another customer-facing role.
Proven experience managing multiple customer accounts, sales opportunities, and concurrent projects with exceptional attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
Ability to understand technical services and translate complex concepts into practical, easy-to-understand guidance.
Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, along with invoicing tools like QuickBooks or equivalent software.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, and project management platforms.
Ability to work independently within a collaborative remote environment while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and accountability.
Availability to work full-time during Mountain Standard Time (MST) or Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours.
Experience in food science, laboratory testing, food manufacturing, dietary supplements, pet food, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Knowledge of food labeling regulations, nutrition facts panels, FDA, USDA, or AAFCO requirements is considered an advantage.


Benefits


Full-time remote position with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
Opportunity to manage customer relationships in a consultative, non-cold-calling environment.
Exposure to laboratory testing, food science, regulatory compliance, and product labeling projects.
Collaborative team culture with close interaction across customer success, operations, and technical teams.
Modern technology stack including HubSpot, Monday.com, QuickBooks, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Teams.
Opportunity to develop expertise within the food science and regulatory compliance sector.
Competitive compensation package based on qualifications and experience.

About the job

Acreditta es una plataforma de credenciales digitales que permite a las organizaciones crear y gestionar insignias, certificados y títulos profesionales utilizando tecnología blockchain.




Acreditta es pionera en credenciales digitales en la región y apoya a más de 250 organizaciones. En conjunto, estas organizaciones han emitido más de un millón credenciales digitales en 15 países, contribuyendo a un mercado laboral más transparente y enfocado en las habilidades.




Descripción del cargo

El cargo de Customer Success Junior es una posición remota de tiempo completo, enfocada en apoyar a los clientes en el uso cotidiano de la plataforma de Acreditta.




Sus responsabilidades incluyen responder consultas, acompañar a nuevos usuarios durante el proceso de onboarding y garantizar una experiencia fluida en la gestión de credenciales digitales. La persona monitoreará la satisfacción de los clientes, recopilará sus comentarios y colaborará con los equipos internos para resolver inconvenientes y mejorar el servicio.




Las actividades diarias incluyen gestionar tickets de soporte, documentar preguntas frecuentes, preparar guías prácticas sencillas y participar en reuniones virtuales con clientes y colegas. El cargo también contempla hacer seguimiento a métricas básicas de uso y ayudar a identificar oportunidades para aumentar el valor entregado al cliente y fortalecer su retención.




Requisitos

Experiencia de uno o 2 años en servicio al cliente (idealmente SaaS)
Sólidas habilidades de atención y soporte al cliente para ayudar eficazmente a los usuarios.
Habilidades de comunicación claras y profesionales, tanto escritas como verbales, para explicar procesos y soluciones de manera sencilla y fácil de comprender.

About the job

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Paylocity is an award-winning provider of cloud-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy-to-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.

While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.

We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.

Help our award-winning technology company run effectively as you take on big challenges and find solutions with a position in Operations.

Use your problem-solving skills to shape the way others see Paylocity. Launch your career with us!

This is a 100% in-office role based at our Guadalajara, MX location. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on-site five days per week during designated work hours.

Position Overview

The Support Specialist I plays a pivotal role within our organization, acting as the front-line support and dedicated resource for employees of Paylocity's Spending Accounts and COBRA clients. In this role, you will receive, prioritize, document, and actively resolve client requests from an inbound call center (and/or email) queue, ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction. As a Support Specialist I, you will provide support for client employee Spending Account and COBRA participants, answering questions about their accounts, plans, processes, platform navigation/usage, etc. This position requires a combination of technical expertise, strong customer service skills, and the ability to apply critical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve client inquiries.

Responsibilities

The primary duties of the Support Specialist include, but are not limited to:


Provides support to client employees with inquiries about their spending accounts, COBRA services/coverage and/or systems access/functions/navigation tied to these topics
Establishes intra- and interdepartmental relationships to prioritize needs, communicate status and timing expectations.
Determines the scope of customer requirements to support responding to inbound inquiries regarding Spending Accounts and COBRA; Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve questions, striving for prompt and accurate solutions.
Achieves objectives by gathering pertinent data, identifying and evaluating options, recommending and executing a course of action
Demonstrate strong ownership of cases; ensure prompt resolution and minimizing aging cases or open items.

title: ⚔️ High Ticket Sales Gladiator
description:
About the job

🚨BEFORE YOU READ ANOTHER WORD...🚨

Apply Here: https://tally.so/r/7RPBv9

Please complete the application after reading the job description.

The candidates who follow directions first are usually the same ones who succeed here.




High Ticket Sales Closer (Remote)

Base Salary + Uncapped Commission Opportunity

Wanted: A Sales Gladiator Who Refuses To Lose.

You've probably read dozens of sales job postings that all sound exactly the same.

"We're looking for a motivated sales representative..."

"Must have excellent communication skills..."

"Competitive salary..."

Boring.

If you're looking for an average sales job...

Close this page - Do it now.

Didn't? Well.... here we go

This isn't one.

We're looking for someone who hates losing more than they enjoy winning.

Someone who treats every sales call like it's the championship round.

Someone who refuses to let objections become excuses.

Someone who understands that sales isn't about convincing people.

It's about transforming businesses while building the life you've always wanted.

If that sounds like you...

Keep reading.




About The Business Toolkit

The Business Toolkit is a U.S.-based business growth company helping entrepreneurs launch, grow, and scale businesses through logo design, branding, web design and development, software, printing, signage, and digital marketing. Since 2017, we've helped over 30,000 businesses worldwide build brands that stand out and grow faster. Today, we're one of the highest-rated business growth companies in America, trusted by startups, small businesses, and Fortune 500 brands alike.

We're rated #1 for Websites & Marketing on Trustpilot.

We have thousands of 5-star reviews across Google, Facebook, and Trustpilot.

Our mission is ambitious.

Create 1,000,000 brands by 2030.

Position our group of companies for IPO.

Build a company that changes millions of lives, starting with our customers and our team.

If that mission excites you, you'll fit right in.




This Isn't Your Typical Sales Job

Most salespeople spend their day cold calling, begging for appointments, selling one product, and competing for bad leads.

Not here.

Our marketing team generates qualified opportunities every day.

You'll work with entrepreneurs who are actively looking to grow.

You'll have access to 500+ products and services ranging from under $100 to enterprise solutions exceeding $20,000.

Logo Design.

Brand Identity.

Websites.

Printing.

Vehicle Wraps.

Custom Signage.

SEO.

Google Ads.

Social Media.

Software.

AI Solutions.

Marketing.

And virtually every service a business needs to grow.

One customer can become ten.

One sale can become a long-term partnership worth tens of thousands of dollars.

There is no ceiling.




Who We're Looking For

You don't panic when someone says...

"I need to think about it."

"Send me more information."

"I'll call you next week."

"My business partner has to approve it."

You've heard every objection imaginable.

You know objections aren't rejection.

They're opportunities.

You follow up.

Then follow up again.

Then again.

Not because you're annoying.

Because professionals understand that fortunes are made in the follow-up.

Average salespeople quit after one attempt.

Elite salespeople stay in the game until there's a decision.

Yes or no.

Either answer is better than silence.




We Don't Hire Backgrounds. We Hire Producers.

Your resume doesn't impress us nearly as much as your results.

Show us:

• Leaderboards you've topped

• Quotas you've crushed

• Revenue you've generated

• Close rates you've maintained

• Commission checks you're proud of

• The biggest sale you've ever closed

If you've consistently outperformed everyone around you, we want to meet you.




Your Responsibilities

• Manage and close warm inbound B2B and B2C opportunities

• Conduct discovery calls and business growth consultations

• Build relationships with entrepreneurs and business owners

• Recommend solutions that genuinely help clients grow

• Present and close high-ticket products and services

• Maintain detailed CRM notes and pipeline management

I’m helping Decolure find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of DTC Operations Lead.

Compensation:

USD 4K - 9K/month




Location:

Remote: Mexico




Mission of Decolure:

"We specialize in transforming a house into a home that the buyer is looking for, or a space that perfectly reflects your family’s style, needs and comfort (redesign)."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear.
You have +4 years experience in Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing).
English - Fully fluent




Responsibilities and more:

JOB TITLE: DTC Operations Lead

LOCATION: Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full Time




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a DTC Operations Lead to be the single owner of execution velocity for our Shopify direct-to-consumer channel. This is the most critical hire in our DTC buildout. We already have the strategy, the specs, the infrastructure, and the data — what we need is someone to make sure the work actually ships, every day, every week, without strategic conversations getting stuck in a document on Google Drive.

You will NOT be the person running ad accounts (that's the Growth Marketer). You will NOT be the person writing Liquid code (that's Implementation Specialist). You will NOT be the person producing creative assets (that's UGC Creators + Content Producer). Your job is to make sure ALL of those people are shipping, on-brief, on-time, every single week — and that the work they produce moves our DTC readiness score, revenue, and margin in the right direction.

This role is 70% execution management, 20% strategic decision-making, 10% hands-on analytical work. If you want to run ads or build pages yourself, this is not the right role. If you thrive on turning chaos into rhythm and watching a team ship more in a month than most DTC teams ship in a quarter, keep reading.




ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Execution Velocity & Team Management — 50% of your time

Daily standup (async or sync) with Growth Marketer, Implementation Specialist, UGC Creators — 15 minutes max, focused on "what shipped yesterday, what ships today, what's blocked"

ClickUp ownership: every open task has a clear owner, deadline, and acceptance criteria; every completed task has a tested outcome

Weekly sprint planning from the backlog of 17 existing specs + incoming priorities

Weekly sprint review: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes next week

Remove blockers: if Implementation Specialist is stuck on a Klaviyo flow, you unblock within 24 hours — you don't let it sit for a week

Pull from the AI agent's prioritized recommendations and assign — you should never have a team member wondering what to work on

DTC Performance Accountability — 20% of your time

Own the top-line DTC KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, CAC, AOV, email list growth, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin

Weekly performance review with the team, using data from the AI agent's dashboards

Monthly performance review with the CEO: what moved, what didn't, why, and what you're changing

Quarterly P&L review: contribution margin, LTV:CAC, channel profitability

Accountable for moving the DTC Readiness Tracker from 62% to 90% within 90 days of starting

Strategic Decision-Making — 20% of your time

Decide what the team works on this week, this month, this quarter — aligned with CEO priorities

Evaluate competing priorities: when the agent surfaces a conversion leak vs. the Growth Marketer wants to test a new creative vs. Ahmad has a blog CTA to ship, you prioritize

Approve or reject A/B test recommendations (with data justification)

Approve creative briefs before UGC creators start production

Cross-channel coordination: when Amazon runs a promotion, you decide DTC's response; when TikTok wants to test a creator, you validate the DTC implications

Escalate to CEO only what requires CEO-level decisions (budget above $500/day, pricing changes, strategic shifts) — you handle everything else

Hands-On Analytical Work — 10% of your time

Read dashboards daily — you should know the top 5 DTC metrics before your team tasks

Read Microsoft Clarity session recordings weekly (not optional) — you should know firsthand where users get stuck on mobile

Spot-check the AI agent's recommendations — verify the logic, don't just rubber-stamp

Identify when the AI agent is missing context and feed it back (this makes the agent better over time)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90-DAY SCORECARD)

Month 1 — Command of the Team

Daily standup rhythm established with all team members

ClickUp fully groomed: every open task has owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Weekly sprint + review cadence operating

All 17 existing specs triaged and prioritized into a 12-week roadmap

First 5 specs shipped to production (not just drafted — LIVE)

You can verbally walk the CEO through current DTC performance, top risks, and this week's priorities in 5 minutes without notes

Month 2 — Execution at Pace

At least 10 specs shipped to production (cumulative from month 1)

DTC Readiness Tracker moved from 62% to 72%+

Store-wide conversion rate improved 0.2pp+ from baseline

Meta ROAS above 1.5x sustained

Email list growth accelerating (measurable WoW)

Zero specs older than 30 days sitting "in progress" — everything moves or gets killed

Month 3 — DTC Revenue Inflection

DTC revenue trajectory toward $30K+/month

DTC Readiness Tracker at 85%+

Blended ROAS above 2x sustained

CAC trending toward $15 target

Team is operating without needing daily direction — sprint cadence is self-sustaining

Clear strategic plan for months 4-6 submitted to CEO




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience (Non-Negotiable):

4+ years leading DTC e-commerce operations (Shopify, BigCommerce, or direct Shopify Plus) at a brand doing $500K-$10M/year

Demonstrable track record of running a cross-functional DTC team: paid media, CRO, email, content, implementation

Experience managing remote teams across time zones (you will manage people in 2-4 countries simultaneously)

Project management fluency: ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Linear, Monday — doesn't matter which, but you must have run a real backlog, not a checklist

Data literacy: you can read GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo, and Search Console fluently — not an expert in each, but competent enough to verify a specialist's work

Strong communication: written (async updates, briefs, escalation emails) and verbal (CEO check-ins, team standups)

Fluent English: written and verbal — this is a CEO-facing and team-leadership role

Strong Preferences:

Experience at a company running DTC alongside Amazon (cross-channel dynamics are a daily reality here)

Experience with bedding, home, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands

Experience working with AI tools as part of daily workflow (not just "used ChatGPT a few times")

Shopify Plus admin experience (not required, but a plus)

Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, Judge.me, Gorgias, or similar tool fluency

Nice-to-Have:

Background as a former Growth Marketer or CRO specialist (you understand what your team is doing at a technical level)

Experience in a 5-10 person company (you understand scrappy execution, not Fortune 500 bureaucracy)

Experience building or scaling a DTC channel from <$500K to $2M+ ARR

Comfort with light Shopify theme edits, basic HTML/Liquid (so you can spot-check work)




WHAT WE PROVIDE

A fully built strategic and data infrastructure: 17 specs, 86 processes documented, 35+ automation scripts, 13 active crons, all platform APIs integrated

An AI operations agent that delivers daily analytics, weekly summaries, competitor intel, creative briefs, PDP audit specs, email flow designs, and P&L analysis — you inherit a research and planning team on day 1

A 90-day playbook to move DTC Readiness from 62% to 90% — not a blank page

Direct CEO access for decisions above your authority level — clear escalation path, no middle-management bureaucracy

Growing revenue trajectory: DTC is our #1 strategic growth priority for 2026-2027

Clear promotion path: as DTC scales to $2M+ ARR, this role evolves into Head of DTC




DEAL-BREAKERS — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Your experience is primarily Amazon or marketplace operations — the playbooks don't transfer

You've only ever been an individual contributor (paid media specialist, CRO analyst) — this is a management role requiring team leadership

You've only ever led large teams (15+ people with clear functional silos) — this is a scrappy execution role where you lead 4-6 people across functions

You prefer strategy over execution — this is 70% execution, 20% strategy, 10% analysis

You need extensive direction from above — you will be given goals and scorecards, not task lists

You're uncomfortable delegating to an AI agent or receiving AI-generated specs — that's a core workflow of this role




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position. 

Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager

Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry

A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels

Employee discounts on Decolure products




Your potential leader(s):

Erik Fisher -



Desired Skills and Experience

Direct-to-consumer marketing (DTC marketing), Shopify Plus, Shopify, Paid media, Meta Ads Manager, Linear, Klaviyo, Growth marketing, Google Search Console, Data analysis

Department: Performance

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!



About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Performance Department (performance marketing) as our Project Lead, you'll be responsible for providing stability within your team by supporting your direct manager through mentoring, training, and developing team members. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Making expert-level project contributions, autonomously leading projects of varying complexity to a high standard of quality, with a focus on testing and creative problem solving, maintaining client success where applicable and reasonable while supporting others around you and teaching others to do the same.
Client: Exemplifying Thrive's standards for client success through strong day-to-day communication, agile and proactive problem solving, project management, and anticipating client needs.
People: Accountable for training and developing team members to be world-class performance marketers with Thrive's standards of quality and impact to aid in the growth of company performance expertise.
Company: Understands and takes action to be a key influencer and innovator in helping Thrive improve our products and services, and enhancing team member contributions while aligning individual contributions with the wider team or program objectives.


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s mission, values, and processes, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard onto your team, emphasizing on building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll put your learning, skills, and experiences into action by supporting on assigned client accounts, preparing and leading client calls, and helping your Strategist manage projects end-to-end.
In your first 90 days you’ll have become integrated into the team, becoming an efficient contributor and trusted partner to your assigned clients and team members. You’re starting to train others on the work we do. 


Qualifications


You have executed, maintained, and scaled performance marketing accounts of $100k-200k USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time including Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others.
You have experience directly collaborating with and supporting team members to achieve project & team goals. You have coached, mentored, or trained people before, helping them reach their career development goals.
You have advanced analytical skills and experience using data visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You have built your own dashboards before, or automated some manual reporting to make it more efficient. 
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, lead gen, etc), and have been responsible for leading projects end-to-end, including delegation to more junior team members.
You have successfully managed and grown client relationships via weekly touchpoint meetings and asynchronous communication, and were able to make strategic recommendations that helped grow their business in the form of quarterly planning meetings or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. About the job

Ready to take your career global?

Marketing in Global Payments is more than campaigns and content. It is how we shape perception, build trust, and drive growth across a fast-moving global payments landscape. As a Marketing Specialist you will help bring our products, services, and channels to life in ways that connect with clients and unlock new opportunities.

What You’ll Own


 Shape marketing programs that drive measurable growth, turning strategic goals into campaigns and initiatives that strengthen brand awareness and commercial performance across products and channels
 Create compelling marketing content and messaging that elevates our brand, ensuring consistency across digital, social, and promotional channels while improving engagement and market perception
 Influence go-to-market strategy for products and launches, translating business direction into clear positioning and marketing plans that support successful adoption and growth
 Drive execution of integrated marketing initiatives across teams and partners, ensuring alignment between sales, product, and communications to deliver consistent market impact
 Strengthen how we measure marketing performance and return on investment (ROI), using insights to improve campaign effectiveness, budget use, and future decision making
 Build trusted relationships across internal teams and external partners, improving collaboration and unlocking more effective marketing delivery across complex initiatives
 Improve marketing processes and execution standards, identifying smarter ways of working that increase speed, consistency, and quality of output across campaigns
 Support strategic growth priorities through clear, audience-focused storytelling, helping translate business goals into communications that influence customers and stakeholders


What You Bring


 Experience in marketing, advertising, or digital communications, with the ability to turn strategy into clear, high-impact execution
 Strong understanding of marketing channels and campaign delivery, including digital, social, email, and content-led programs
 Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, engaging messaging, tailored for different audiences and business needs
 Experience working with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and external partners in a fast-paced environment
 Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to measure marketing performance and use insights to improve outcomes
 Confidence working with marketing tools and platforms, such as automation tools and CRM systems (for example Salesforce or similar platforms)
 A proactive, curious approach, with a focus on improving how marketing creates impact and drives growth


It’s a bonus if you have


 Experience in the payments or financial services industry, with an understanding of how products and clients operate in this space
 Exposure to marketing agencies or client services environments, where you’ve managed multiple stakeholders and fast-moving priorities
 Familiarity with marketing automation or CRM-driven campaign execution, helping you connect data, targeting, and performance more effectively


About The Team

You will join a collaborative marketing team working closely with sales, product, and business leaders. Together, you will turn strategy into clear, compelling storytelling that strengthens our brand and supports growth across regions and channels. Every idea you shape helps move Global Payments forward in a competitive, evolving market.

This is your opportunity to influence how we show up in the market, strengthen how we communicate value, and help scale marketing impact across the business. You will work in an environment that values ownership, creativity, and continuous improvement as we evolve how commerce works globally.

In this role, you’ll own how marketing ideas become real impact, from shaping campaigns and messaging to strengthening brand consistency and measuring what drives results. You’ll create clarity in how we communicate, influence how we position our solutions, and help unlock growth across products, channels, and partnerships.

Our Perks - What We’ll Bring For You

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution

Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business

Access to learning, development and on-the-job experiences that expand your expertise

A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter

Time to give back through community and charity initiatives

A global employee assistance programme to support your wellbeing

Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Diversity and EEO Statements 

Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.

Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. Global Payments provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by law. description:
About the job

About Apply
